Solid basics on Ab initio and its components 
Solid on Bid volume data processing and loading into Oracle and Teradata 
Basic knowledge on unix commands and shell scripting **
 Job Responsibilities
Collaborate with business in gathering requirements, write functional requirements, Write Technical specifications 
Develop and enhance existing application or build new applications using Ab initio, Unix, Linux, Oracle, Teradata, Control-M scheduler technology (all these are required skills) 
Develop and unit test code to ensure it is meeting functional, technical and business requirements and meeting company coding standards 
Participate in system and UAT testing 
Implement code per company standard tools and guidelines 
Provide required support for recovery of production jobs failures ensuring recovery for failures withing agreed times 
Collaborate with business and other IT contacts 
Work on new projects, small enhancement to existing applications 
Deliver documentation and code with 0 defects and on-time with quality
